name: pawservation
description: Multi-tenant, embeddable booking widget for pet-sitting businesses (Cloudflare Workers + D1)
_dangerSeedRemote: scripts.seed:remote OVERWRITES the PRODUCTION Cloudflare D1 database (pawservation-db --remote) with sql/schema.sql + sql/seed.sql + sql/seed-demo.sql, replacing real tenant data with demo tenants/bookings and resetting demo sitter logins to a password documented in this public repo. It happened for real on 2026-07-28. The script is guarded behind CONFIRM_SEED_REMOTE=overwrite-production -- if you are reading this because you copy-pasted the underlying `wrangler d1 execute pawservation-db --remote --file=...` commands out of the script to run by hand, that guard does not protect you: think twice before running them against the remote DB.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n widget,worker -c magenta,cyan "vite build --watch" "wrangler dev"
scripts.seed:local: wrangler d1 execute pawservation-db --local --file=./sql/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute pawservation-db --local --file=./sql/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute pawservation-db --local --file=./sql/seed-demo.sql
scripts.seed:remote: [ "$CONFIRM_SEED_REMOTE" = "overwrite-production" ] || { echo; echo '!! seed:remote OVERWRITES the PRODUCTION D1 (pawservation-db --remote) !!'; echo 'It runs, in order: sql/schema.sql (CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS), sql/seed.sql, then'; echo 'sql/seed-demo.sql (both INSERT OR REPLACE) -- replacing real tenant rows with'; echo 'the three demo tenants, ~38 demo bookings, and resetting the demo sitter'; echo 'logins to the password documented in this public repo. This happened for'; echo 'real against prod on 2026-07-28 and had to be hand-repaired.'; echo; echo 'To proceed anyway: CONFIRM_SEED_REMOTE=overwrite-production npm run seed:remote'; echo; exit 1; } && echo 'CONFIRMED -- seeding PRODUCTION pawservation-db (remote): schema.sql, seed.sql, seed-demo.sql' && wrangler d1 execute pawservation-db --remote --file=./sql/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute pawservation-db --remote --file=./sql/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute pawservation-db --remote --file=./sql/seed-demo.sql
